title: Kenyan Sweet Potato Fritters
description: Crispy fried fritters made with mashed sweet potatoes, a hint of Kenyan spices, and a crunchy jagged coating.
instructions: Grate the sweet potatoes and set aside.
Mix together the flour, jagged, crispy fried onions, and Kenyan spices.
Add the grated sweet potatoes and salt to the mixture. Mix well.
Add water as needed to form a thick batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the batter into the oil.
Fry until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
